mapper.select: select id, admin_id, username, token_hash, udid, status, expire_time, create_time, last_active_time from cms_admin_token where token_hash = #{tokenHash} and status = 1 limit 1
mapper.update: update cms_admin_token set status = 0, last_active_time = current_timestamp where token_hash = #{tokenHash} and status = 1
